<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes them.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and performing actions on them, such as logging whether they are adults or minors. It is used by various parts of the application to handle user data and enforce access controls based on age.

@attribute {Array<javascript.user.User>} users - The list of users managed by this class. It is initialized as an empty array and is modified by the `addUser` method.
</DOCSTRING>
